The '''Nelvana Gas Cluster''' was a gas cluster in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents claimed to be a survey crew heading to the cluster when they were challenged by [[Bannistar Station]] officials.
